summary: The PC App Store browses, installs and updates apps. Apple's alternative-marketplace services (app library, install tokens, website install, age-rating checks) have no counterpart, and the store is not an SDK API.
rea_evidence: not captured: REA capture pending (tools/parity/rea-page.sh not run in this batch); facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.feature: Browse and install apps from a store
features.note: GET, progress and OPEN flow with an Updates tab; the store is the system store only, not an SDK component
no catalog of installed apps that a third-party marketplace can manage
no website install link or browser install hook

features.apple: App License Delivery SDK, install verification token

features.note: no age-rating check at install time

features.apple: TransactionReporting, Reporting transactions for the Core Technology Commission
features.note: a commission reporting service that Apple runs for App Store purchases

gaps: No SDK API for a third-party marketplace to list, install and update apps.
No website install path and no signed install verification.
